name: Investment Policy Advisory Committee
agenda_text:
July 20, 2021
10:15
AM
Council Chambers of City Hall
340 Palos Verdes Drive West
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
AGENDA
OF A REGULAR MEETING
OF THE INVESTMENT POLICY ADVISORY COMMITTEE
OF THE CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make an inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The Investment Policy Advisory Committee is a new committee, effective July 1, 2017. With the City Treasurer, the Committee shall be responsible for recommending investment brokers, proposing changes to investment policy and practices, presenting investment reports, and evaluating and recommending banking-related matters. Meetings are to review, discuss and develop recommendation on matters such as investment and banking vendors, policy, transactions, returns and performance, brokers, and strategy.
The Investment Policy Advisory Committee, at the direction of the Chairman with concurrence of the Committee, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the Secretary Pro Tempore to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and, if any, documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the Secretary Pro Tempore at 310-378-0383, at least 24 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The Investment Policy Advisory Committee welcomes and encourages public participation at the Investment Policy Advisory Committee meetings. This meeting will be held via videoconference only in order to reduce the risk of spreading COVID-19 and pursuant to the Governor's Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20 and the County of Los Angeles Public Health Officer's Safer at Home Order (revised March 21, 2020). All votes taken during this teleconference meeting will be by roll call vote, and the vote will be publicly reported.
HOW TO VIEW THE MEETING: No physical location from which members of the public may observe the meeting and offer public comment will be provided. The meeting will not be livestreamed. You may attend the meeting through a computer or telephone:
BY COMPUTER: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/86389919825
Zoom Meeting ID: 863 8991 9825
BY TELEPHONE: 1 669 900 9128, Enter Code: 86389919825#
HOW TO PARTICIPATE BEFORE THE MEETING: Members of the public are encouraged to submit email correspondence to pvefinance@pvestates.org before the meeting begins. The email will be distributed to all Members. Public correspondence submitted electronically via email will be provided to the legislative body, but will not be read aloud at the meeting.
HOW TO PARTICIPATE DURING THE MEETING: If you would like to address the Members during the meeting, please utilize the "Raise Hand" feature during the meeting, or email pvefinance@pvestates.org with (1) the agenda item on which you'd like to speak, and (2) the phone number and/or Zoom display name from which you will be calling in to the meeting. This will replace the in-person speaker cards.
Agenda reports and other disclosable public documents relating to each Agenda Item are available on the City's website under Investment Policy Advisory Meeting Agendas at www.pvestates.org.
CALL TO ORDER
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ROLL CALL
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
PRESENTATIONS
COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
This portion of the agenda is reserved for comments from the public on items which are NOT on the agenda. Due to state law, no action can be taken by the Committee this evening on matters presented under this section. If the Committee determines action is warranted, the item may be referred to staff or placed on a future Committee agenda.
CONSENT AGENDA
1.
INVESTMENT POLICY ADVISORY COMMITTEE MINUTES Recommendation: Review and Approve.
Minutes
OLD BUSINESS
2.
CONTINUED DISCUSSION OF A PORTFOLIO INVESTMENT STRATEGY WITH FOCUS ON TARGETS FOR VARIOUS INVESTMENT TERMS
Recommendation: Continue discussion and make recommendations to the Chair/City Treasurer as Deemed Appropriate.
Staff Report
NEW BUSINESS
3.
APPOINTMENT OF ERIN SMITH AS SECRETARY OF THE INVESTMENT POLICY ADVISORY COMMITTEE Recommendation: Adopt a Motion appointing Finance Analyst Erin Smith as Secretary of the Investment Policy Advisory Committee.
4.
REVIEW THE QUARTERLY INVESTMENT REPORT FOR THE QUARTER ENDING JUNE 30, 2021
Recommendation: Review the Quarterly Investment Report, and make recommendations to the Chair/City Treasurer as deemed appropriate.
Quarterly Investment Policy
ADJOURNMENT TO TUESDAY, October 19, 2021 AT 4:00 P.M.
i.
This Investment Policy Advisory Committee meeting can be viewed on demand thereafter on the City Website at www.pvestates.org.
